title: The Staff of Magnus
description: After the crisis at the College of Winterhold, Mirabelle Ervine sends you to Labyrinthian to retrieve the Staff of Magnus, the only artifact capable of containing Ancano's abuse of the Eye of Magnus. Navigate the ancient ruins, defeat the Dragon Priest Morokei, and return the Staff to Tolfdir.

base_facts: I sent the student to Labyrinthian to retrieve the Staff of Magnus.
I gave them the Torc of Labyrinthian and Savos Aren's Amulet to gain entry.
The Staff is the only way to contain Ancano's abuse of the Eye of Magnus.

MIRABELLE_BRIEFING: The student has departed for Labyrinthian with the Torc and Amulet.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I am holding the defensive line against Ancano inside the College.
The student has successfully recovered the Staff of Magnus from Labyrinthian.
With the Staff of Magnus recovered, we finally have a way to contain the Eye of Magnus.

base_facts: I am a Dragon Priest entombed deep within Labyrinthian.
I wield the Staff of Magnus.
I drain the magicka of any who dare enter my domain.
Savos Aren sealed me behind a magical barrier using the lives of his companions.

DEFEAT_MOROKEI: I have been defeated and the Staff of Magnus taken from me.

base_facts: I am at the College of Winterhold dealing with the magical crisis.
The student must return the Staff of Magnus to me so we can stop Ancano.

RETURN_TO_TOLFDIR: The student has returned with the Staff of Magnus.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The student has returned from Labyrinthian with the Staff of Magnus.
The student must use the Staff of Magnus on the Eye of Magnus to break Ancano's hold.
The magical crisis at the College is worsening, and we must act immediately.

base_facts: I once led an expedition into Labyrinthian with five companions from the College.
We were no match for Morokei.
I sealed Morokei behind a barrier, sacrificing my companions to maintain it.
I serve the Thalmor and Ancano.
I was sent to intercept the Staff of Magnus from anyone who retrieves it.
I am harnessing the power of the Eye of Magnus at the College.
The Staff of Magnus is the only thing that can counter my power.

QUEST_COMPLETE: The student has retrieved the Staff of Magnus, the only artifact capable of countering my power.
I remain in control of the Eye of Magnus, but the Staff threatens my plans.
My magical barrier protects me, but the Staff of Magnus can disrupt it.

beats.comment: Mirabelle sends the player to Labyrinthian after the Containment crisis.
Player has entered Labyrinthian and is searching for the Staff.
Player defeats Morokei and retrieves the Staff of Magnus.
Player returns to Tolfdir at the College with the Staff.
Quest finished - Staff of Magnus recovered.
